profile.headline: Sr. Engineer at OpenTable
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 18+ years of experience designing, building, and modernizing enterprise systems across property management, financial services, and critical infrastructure. I specialize in .NET/C# microservices architecture on Azure, distributed messaging (NServiceBus, RabbitMQ, CQRS), and systematically transforming legacy monoliths into scalable, cloud-native platforms.
 
I take a long-term view of the systems I work on. I believe in budgeting time for technical debt and automation, roughly 10% of our effort, so the team can keep improving the foundation while still shipping features on schedule. I'm a strong believer in modernizing legacy code, leaning on hard-won experience, and always leaving the codebase cleaner than I found it.
 
What I bring to a team:
 
Distributed Systems Depth: Designed and operated event-driven microservices using NServiceBus, RabbitMQ, the Outbox pattern, and SQL Persistence on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), scaling services to handle 4× peak load.

Measurable Business Impact: Architected an API-driven integration that drove a 25% lift in client retention, and built an integration layer that cut new-client onboarding time by 40%.

Legacy Modernization: Led migrations from monolithic WinForms/.NET Framework applications to .NET Core microservices with IdentityServer4, CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployments.

Security & Quality Champion: Veracode SAST champion across multiple product lines; established Dev/QA/UAT environments and standardized release branching strategies.

Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Work closely with overseas developers across time zones, mentoring them through hands-on code reviews, documented architecture (Lucidchart), and clear user stories, raising the quality and consistency of what the whole team ships.
 
Core Stack: C#, .NET 8, ASP.NET Core, Azure (AKS, Application Insights), Docker, Kubernetes, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis, NServiceBus, RabbitMQ, Entity Framework Core, GitHub Actions, Jenkins
 
Authorized to work in the United States under TN Visa status. No sponsorship required.
 
Open to U.S.-based full-time Senior Software Engineer and Backend Developer roles.

Contact: j3patel+linkedin@gmail.com

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designing and operating cloud-native microservices on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) for MRI’s property management platform, using ASP .NET Core, NServiceBus, RabbitMQ, Docker, and SQL Server
  
•    Architected a secure API-driven integration between MRI’s PMX Accounting platform and Angus Facility Management, synchronizing lease data, work orders, and receivables — contributing to a 25% increase in client retention  
•    Designed and developed cloud-native microservices for capacity management, property reservations, and mobile push notifications (Firebase) on AKS using RabbitMQ and NServiceBus  
•    Implemented SQL Persistence with NServiceBus Outbox pattern, significantly improving message reliability and enabling services to handle 4× peak load  
•    Built a shared telemetry library integrated with Azure Application Insights, enabling root-cause analysis and performance bottleneck identification during load testing  
•    Led infrastructure-level upgrade of NHibernate and NServiceBus across a legacy Web API, leveraging Copilot-assisted refactoring to ensure a safe, zero-regression transition  
•    Provided technical leadership to offshore teams through documented user stories, Lucidchart architecture diagrams, and hands-on code reviews  
•    Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins with modular build steps, centralized error handling, and Veracode SAST scans for security compliance  
•    Implemented mobile push notifications for iOS and Android applications using Firebase SDK

positions.title: Software Developer (Middle Tier/Back-end)
positions.description:
Developed microservices for Angus Systems’ facility management platform (acquired by MRI Software), building cloud-ready services using .NET Core, Docker, and Azure Kubernetes Service

•	Developed microservices for the Ola Health Screen and Property Reservation applications on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), including capacity management and push notification services
•	Integrated Application Insights across all microservices, collecting telemetry data for monitoring and analysis in Azure cloud, reducing troubleshooting times
•	Worked closely with product owners in an Agile scrum team to translate business requirements into user stories with clear, testable acceptance criteria

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Led integration architecture and platform modernization for Fujifilm Canada’s digital production and retail photo systems
•	Re-architected the Partial Order Resource Service, optimizing cross-system integration and reducing operational cost — recognized with the Fujifilm Canada President’s Award
•	Spearheaded modernization from monolithic WinForms/.NET Framework applications to .NET Core microservices with IdentityServer4, improving maintainability and deployment agility
•	Established standardized Dev/QA/UAT environments and release branching strategies, decreasing production incidents and ensuring a smooth Gifting Product platform launch

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Built and maintained integration services and production applications for Fujifilm Canada’s retail photo processing ecosystem
•	Designed a flexible integration layer for onboarding new retail clients, supporting XML/CSV/JSON transformations and cutting implementation time by 40%
•	Automated build and deployment pipelines for WinForms and Windows Services via TFS 2017, significantly reducing release cycle time
•	Refactored a legacy GDI+/C++ rendering engine using TDD techniques (Google Test) and resolved critical memory leak issues using Dr. Memory
•	Built PowerShell-based monitoring scripts (watchdog suite) to track production services and alert teams via email and SMS

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed embedded software and build infrastructure for Smiths Detection’s chemical and biological threat detection instruments
•	Implemented signal-processing and filtering algorithms in C++ for detection instrument data pipelines, collaborating with firmware and analysis algorithm engineers
•	Designed control-and-status architecture for micro-controller communication across multiple hardware devices
•	Automated OS migration by writing Bash/Make scripts to build custom RT kernels and ISO images for Debian Linux
•	Created Redmine documentation for build processes and software component architecture
positions.insights: Skills: Bash · DPKG · Debian · Valgrind · Linux · GNU Debugger · GNU Make · C++

positions.title: Programmer (as Contractor)
positions.description:
Maintained and enhanced enterprise document-generation systems for financial services clients
•	Maintained and enhanced Perl-based document-generation software producing bank statements, insurance policies, and checks for enterprise clients (HTML/XML input → PDF output)
•	Served as cross-functional Business Analyst on occasion, writing specifications for client change requests
•	Managed production support and regression/UAT testing, ensuring SLA compliance across commercial client contracts
positions.insights: Skills: Windows Server · Perl · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed device drivers, API libraries, and test infrastructure for Sangoma’s analog and digital telephony hardware product line
•	Extended analog TDM voice device driver capacity from 4 to 24 lines by redesigning and unifying the TDM API and Zaptel API front ends in C, directly increasing analog card sales
•	Implemented new device driver events (Reverse Polarity Detection, Flash/Wink, Loop Current Measure) by configuring VoiceDAA and ProSLIC front-end chipsets
•	Enhanced Perl-based hardware configuration utilities, resulting in a 25% reduction in telephony support calls
•	Developed C test applications for address bus, data bus, and component validation on new hardware platforms
•	Automated load testing of Sangoma hardware using custom Bash test scripts
•	Integrated NBE Gateway with third-party SIP gateways (3CX, Brekeke) to deliver complete TDM-to-VoIP PBX solutions
•	Provided L2/L3 support for T1/E1 PRI, BRI, and analog cards, troubleshooting physical layer, protocol layer, and application-level issues (Asterisk, FreeSWITCH)
positions.insights: Skills: Bash · TDM · Freeswitch · Asterisk · ISDN PRI/BRI · Voice over IP (VoIP) · SIP · C (Programming Language) · Perl · C++
